reviews.title: Mrs Laz
reviews.text: Worst airline ever! Flight was delayed by 3 hours and therefore we missed our connection. There was no help and any interest from the employees to address the issue and help. There is no Bulgarian service counter at Frankfurt so 8 people were left with absolutely no help! We had to pay for a hotel ourselves and thank god we were all able to fly the next day with Lufthansa. I would avoid this airline as the plague.
reviews.author: Virginia L

reviews.title: Very expensive
reviews.text: Cheapest flights between the two Bulgarian cities Sofia and Varna are like 2-4 times more expensive than Ryanair and this is the Bulgarian national aviation company! There is no excuse to have such high prices when their internal fees/expenses should be way lower considering the salaries of Bulgarians versus UK crew and the additional airport/airspace fees!
reviews.author: Momchil

reviews.title: Excellent flight
reviews.text: Flight to Paris for the Easter break. Apparently it was full and they gave me a seat in business class. The food and business class itself matched what I've seen on other European airlines.
reviews.author: Ogi0

reviews.title: Decades behind other airlines
reviews.text: I want to like Bulgaria Air so much! I have used them many times over the years, mostly out of necessity, but would feel proud I’m supporting Bulgarian airline. I’m afraid that won’t be the case anymore ever. Bulgaria air reschedules almost every flight I book. Honestly. Almost every time. In addition, they have expensive airline ticket prices, but a budget airline service. The website is awful, you can’t do anything through it, and it hasn’t been updated in 10 years. The e-tickets sent over email have been the same in the last 20 years: totally unreadable. But most of all…. Terrible customer support. One out of perhaps 10 times I have called or emailed about changes or information they have been adequate. The rest of the time: rude, uneducated, spelling mistakes sort of level. What finally make me write a review is that they have no way, no way whatsoever to change my flight, despite me having flights changed many times in the past (for a fee). Outright refusal. I don’t understand this: I’m offering to pay you so you move my flight from date A to date B, giving you days of notice, and you say no? Ok, I will just book with another airline and give money to them. Makes no sense but it’s your loss. The only positive, and one star is for that, is their pet policy. I transported my cat with them sometime ago and it was all very smooth. I just wish they weren’t decades behind in everything and made it easier for people to pay them instead of run to competitors.
reviews.author: Marie G

reviews.title: Ok flight
reviews.text: 4 passengers flying from Hannover to Marsa Alam and return. Flights were fine and on time, leg room limited and you could buy food/drinks (quite expensive). No in flight entertainment (bring your own:-)) I found it hard to find out how much hand luggage we could bring, but we were fine with our 2 trolleys (normal cabin luggage size) and 2 back packs (for all 4 of us). Booked via travellink and they said to be at the airport 3 hours before flight, as there was no online check in. Turns out the check in does not open until 2 hours before the flight, so could have slept 1 hour more (important, when your flight is 7.35 am!)
reviews.author: DKtoAD

reviews.title: Acts like low cost flight company
reviews.text: I never had any problems with the company and flights until 6th of January 2023. We were traveling with our baby and went to the business class queue in Sofia because this is how it’s supposed to be when traveling with a baby on any airport. We were told to go to the economy class queue at the end and wait there. The queue was huge as you can imagine but we have done what we were told. When our turn finally came the person on the desk told us that the plane is overbooked and there is no place for us although we have tickets and we needed to wait. We waited and then I saw that one man who was waiting with us started to check in then we went on the desk. The lady there, she said to be the supervisor was impolite, arrogant and rude to us, she gave us tickets 20 min before the plane departs. She told us it’s our job to manage to catch the plane and told us to be fast. I am underlining that we are with a baby, stroller and two suitcases hand luggage which they did not took. We needed to ask on every queue to go first and run with the baby and this should be a nice and pleasant flight?
reviews.author: Iva S

reviews.title: Don’t bye a ticket!!!!
reviews.text: Don’t bye a ticket.This company is give a sh**t about the customer. Our flight was 8:40 am on 03.01.2023.At 10 am the company supposed to give information about the upcoming flight.One of the crew was sick and they still looking for somebody to replace the sick employee.No organisation at all.I hope we will catch the flight from Sofia to Zurich. Very bad experience we also had with the flights from Zurich to Varna on 23.12.2022.The flight from Zurich to Sofia was ok(because is international airport and they can’t play), but the flight Sofia-Varna was horrible. We took off with 2 hours delays because they didn’t have an airplane to fly.There was no information and a top of that they were so arrogant. That was first and last flights with Bulgaria Air. Never again!!!!
reviews.author: Antoaneta E

reviews.title: If you travel with a pet, it might never make it
reviews.text: We traveled Paris-Sofia with our dog. We were told to wait for our luggauge and the dog but two hours latter, we there was no dog. We asked at the airport a number of times and we were told to keep waiting. At the end they told us the dog was lost and never made it to Bulgaria eventhough we saw from the window of the plane it being borded in its cage before we took off. Apperantly the dog was never taken off the plane, the plane took off to a new destination and when they realised the dog is still on board they had to return the plane again to sofia, land it in order to take out the dog. Absolutly outrageous! They did not follow the required protocols, did not check the plane and the luggauge areas propperly after landing not before taking off, failed to acompany the dog in its journey eventhought they are specifically paid to do so, basically failed at doing their job at delivering the animal from A to B, put the dog's life in huge dangour, cause tremendous stress to the owners and the dog, wasted eveyones time, lied to their customers and did not often compensations nor appologies. Thank god the dog is alive because it could have been on a 10hour flight to a non EU country withouth water and food and could have been potentially dead. I've heard terrible stories about Bulgaria Air and the misterious death of dogs traveling with them but never wanted to belive them. Well... will never travel with them again!!!
reviews.author: Iva S

reviews.title: The worst airline - avoid
reviews.text: They just told me that there's no avialable seats even though I have booked my flight one month ago. There was 1 hour line for checkin which was done by only one person. I was denied entrance and then rebooked for another date. Absolutely disgusting and time wasting.
reviews.author: Kaloyan

reviews.title: 1 word: terrible
reviews.text: BulgariaAir seems to put a loooot of effort in trying to win the price "WORST AIRLINE IN THE WORLD". 1. Case The hallway to the rear toilette (in the airplane) was blocked with the cart, yet still they didn't let me use the one in the front: "only vip/business class people can use it" 2. Case They lost our car seat. I will ask any BulgariaAir staff to explain how can i put my 5 months old baby in the car and drive home? I know that you don't care abput your passangers, but please understand that others + other companies do. TL;DR Save your nerves and time, and just don't book with them.
reviews.author: Marko P

reviews.title: Dont Knock BG Air - Decent Airline
reviews.text: I have floen Bulgaria Air atleast 15 times in the past 7 years. Their aircraft are clean, their fligts are on time and their pricing is quite good. They are NOT in the same ckass as major legacy carriers so trying to compare them to your experience on KLM, Air France, Lufthansa or other major ailines is not a fair direct comparison. I have never had a bad experience with Bulgaria Air. You have to remember that Bulgaria remains somewhat of a third world country, so carriage on their National Airline replicates stern in flight cabin crews. That being said I really like their Embraer aircraft. No major cabin entertainment system supplied but you do get decent food (not alot but decent), comfortable seating, bottle of water, chocolates, an apple and a more than fair Economy Saver Fare to major international destinations like Rome, Paris, Amsterdam along with good donestic fligts between Sofia, Varna and Burgas. Not a bad airline at all;
reviews.author: Kolasa03148

reviews.title: Worst airline ever- avoid at all costs
reviews.text: We had a delayed flight over 2.5 hours as a direct result of the airline staff incompetence. The gate agent spent two hours yelling at customers. Customers that asked politely when the flight would be leaving she responded “I don’t know go away”. She spent her time doing her makeup, going on Instagram, and jumping all over the baggage and bus male staff. She was the most unprofessional flight staff I have ever experienced. When it finally came time to board they scanned too many people on the flight so we sat on the plane for 45 minutes while they tried to figure out who shouldn’t be there. We had a 3 hour layover to our next flight which should have been plenty but missed it due to their incompetence. It was the last flight for three days. The airline told us they owe us no compensation. Worst airline and worst customer service I’ve ever experienced. Will never fly again with them if I have any choice.
reviews.author: n240

reviews.title: Not again
reviews.text: No interaction from the cabin crew at all. No updates from the pilot whatsoever. We paid for extra leg room both ways did not get them on the way home as they had put East Midlands passengers on our flight, it was the case of just grab any seat not happy at all.
reviews.author: deborah b

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I am satisfied with my experience with Bulgaria Air. The flight was on time and all Covid-19 measures were fulfilled. I would especially like to thank the staff on check in at the airport for Bulgaria Air. My mother and my puppy were traveling to Bulgaria. They were extremily helpful and polite. Thank you all once again. Kind Regards Mira Theodorou
reviews.author: andreotis2015

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: The cabin and ground crews are rude and grumpy, my luggage was lost. I finally recieved it after nearly two weeks just to find out that the suitcase was broken. Months later I'm still waiting for a response to my complaint... Completely disappointing!
reviews.author: Nelina H

reviews.title: Slowest check-in queues ever!
reviews.text: 2 desks open for the whole packed flight. Been stood in the check-in queue so far for 45minutes with at least the same to go again. At this rate we will miss our flight, not recommended!
reviews.author: Jon B

reviews.title: Not what it said on the tin.
reviews.text: Booked to fly from Teesside. Cancelled. Rebooked to fly from Newcastle. Changed the flight now landing in Edinburgh. On tarmac for an hour then onward to bourgas. So 3hr30min flight now 6 hours. Won’t refund. Don’t touch this airline with a barge pole.
reviews.author: John L

reviews.title: Should be called BULGARIA SCARE!
reviews.text: Bulgaria Air (better call it Bulgaria Scare or Bulgaria Beware!) canceled the Sofia-Barcelona flight FB477 on 16 July without informing the passengers before! Even the night before the flight, there was no cancellation announcement on their website and I was able to retrieve my booking without any mention of the cancellation. This is the worst airline that one can imagine, showing utmost disrespect for its customers. Beware of it! Avoid it like the plague!
reviews.author: ferdamadr

reviews.title: Fool me once
reviews.text: Prices for checked-in luggage was noted as 30 Euro per piece on the website - you can't pay when you purchase the ticket online- but when we arrived at the airport the price was suddely 50 per piece. The website was being "updated". They weren't very apologeric about it either. Quite oldschool. Obviouly we are going to complain but what are the chances we'll be compensated.. We haven't gotten on the flight yet so no comments on that. But they've deserved this poor review. Just a sad way to do business. Lars, Denmark
reviews.author: Lars J

reviews.title: My trip
reviews.text: Last holiday abroad with my Dad. Started out great with nothing out the ordinary to expect. This was grand until the story of my life. Having water from the hotel room causing dire illness and a mix of food poisoning. I was consumed by this making everything else frankly neither here nor there.
reviews.author: Bryan A

reviews.title: A very bad company.
reviews.text: Very bad aircraft. Fly with white planes, without the mention "Bulgaria Air". Is late, I almost missed my transfer in Schipol. Besides, service is poor : we do not know when the plane is landing, there is no announcement, nothing when there are turbulences. Bad.
reviews.author: Eliot L

reviews.title: Can be improved
reviews.text: The crew was not welcoming and not considering that we are traveling with child! One note: everyone in the place when to business class toilet and when I stand up to change my kid diaper in the front toiled I have been told that this is not possible! I had to walk the whole plane back to get to the other toilet! I did not minded but when I saw everyone using the front toilet (not business class) when I really got offended. In addition the crew was in conflict with 2 people from the place! Another note: the plane was late and I asked for coffee and I was told “we don’t serve coffee” for in 2h later for lunch the lady to ask me if I want tea or coffee! What a joke. The place itself is standard plane and that is why I am giving 3 starts, for the plane and the pilots that managed the place very well.
reviews.author: Elena

reviews.title: Avoid if possible!
reviews.text: Since 2002 I travel often with Domestic flights (USA), international flights, flights within Europe, and domestic flights in Bulgaria. I have experience with many of the airlines from Spirit (low cost) to Lufthansa and Turkish airlines. I avoid flights operated by Bulgaria Air at all costs! The flights often are late or canceled and the customer service is the worst I’ve experienced on any airline ever! They often lose checked bags. It is a nightmare to contact the customer service. The phones have been useless, since 2020, emails take 24 hours to respond. So if you need a conversation with a customer service representative you will wait 24 hours before every response! They do not refund any customer, even if the flight is canceled! I was just offered to use my credit for a flight from Sofia to Miami, that was canceled due to Covid, for a flight from Sofia to Varna! The original flight cost $1000 the domestic flight is $150 and they will not pay me back the difference! The aircrafts are old and have no entertainment of any kind, no WiFi either. Stewardesses are usually rude. The only good thing about Bulgaria Air are the pilots! Flights, from take off to landing, are the best possible!
reviews.author: KeyWest_FL

reviews.title: Worst AIRLINE when things suddenly change
reviews.text: Multiple times I have horrible experience with them. Traveling with my kids and they way they talk to you but thats really not important.When my dad was denied to board the flight due to covid restrictions they absolutely did NOTHING ! They never gave us back the money they offered to give us another ticket. That didnt happen as well. WOSRT AIRLINE! My stroller got totally wrecked one time because they dont put them in a bag .Apparently we had to know that the airline doesnt do that and had to be prepared with a huge bag which I wasnt. All the other little stuff I will not mention because its too much.Never again not reliable as an airline and as staff and crew super UNPROFESSIONAL !
reviews.author: Katina

reviews.title: The worst experience
reviews.text: The most worst experience ever with a woman at the check in that start wasting my mother’s time until the plane went off because of her !!!!! My mother had all the papers needed and is fully vaccinated but the customer service was the worst and there was only one BAD woman at the check in ! The plane went off and they didn’t had any solutions ! Shame on you
reviews.author: ChristiaZreik

reviews.title: Worst Airline i've flown.
reviews.text: The worst airline i have ever flown, not safe, barely any crew. They used the pandemic for a reason to not serve food. Very irresponsible crew NOT SAFE.
reviews.author: SamE

reviews.title: 6 months later still no response from customer service
reviews.text: 6 months and multiple emails later I still haven't heard back from customer service on a reimbursement I am trying to claim. Trip was terrible, poor service, long waiting hours, making stops in different locations to pick up and drop off more passengers... I don't understand how this company still exists.
reviews.author: Ralitsa S

reviews.title: Costumer service?
reviews.text: They have a phone number and an email address but no idea for what. I needed to change something on my ticket. First I tried it several times by email. 10 days before the flight. "We respond within 24 hours" yeah right. The day before my flight, I tried to call them. They hang up after 10 minutes waiting. I tried 20 times. Fuming here.
reviews.author: wladimir45

reviews.title: Surprisingly cheap and high quality business class
reviews.text: What can i say? Booked an economy class ticket and it was on the expensive-ish side (130 EUR for a flight of less than 2 hours). On the check-in, saw long queue which i was in no mood to stand, but also an empty business class checkin counter and a sign offering an upgrade for 100 EUR which i took. Now an expensive economy class becomes a cheap business. The offer to upgrade is permanently available and you can also do it when buying the ticket in the first place. The cabin of the plane (A319) had an actual business class section, for 8 wide seats (2+2). In terms of comfort, seats are fantastic. Pitch could be better but for short haul flights, this is more than fine - how many airlines have actual business class cabin on short flights today? Service was extremely professional and nice, there was a choice of food (chicken or beef, both with rice and some vegetables), some selection of wine and beer, and deserts. No espresso unfortunately, just instant coffee, which is a disappointment.
reviews.author: Alexander Novikov

reviews.title: Disaster
reviews.text: Paid and got my e-ticket a month in advance for flight Sofia-Brussels on sept. 24. Arriving at the airport I discoverd that my flight was canceled. Recieved no warning, neither my travel agent in Belgium (they informed my that it's happens regulary with Bulgaria Air.) Tried to contact them for alternative. Only and very rude responce: waith 2 days, or go to Swiss Air. No apologies, no proposal for alternative flight to Brussels. They din't care. Seems they live still in the old communist era, where a client has to be very happy when it happens that he or she receives a service. With them: never aigain
reviews.author: Hart Beenaert

reviews.title: Customer service bulgaria air I give you 0000
reviews.text: I had a problem with online checking, I tried to contact them, I have called them more than 10 times, after that I have sent a email. Till now no answer. But this is not the first time, this happened. You must be really lucky if this company pick up the phone or answering your email.
reviews.author: Merry G

reviews.title: The worst airlines ever! The worst customer service experience ever! Don't trust these mafiots.
reviews.text: My flight has been cancelled. I was informed by an email, written in English with no explanation. I got a 50% discount voucher by the same airlines early in this year, and used it to book for my summer holidays. I once travelled with them same route. Now, in the summer season, suddenly, they are informing me they removed my flight without giving me the option to change the dates or to offer some support or a compensation. I tried to reach them by the phone about 50 times, no answer, call center never replied. I wrote many emails in English, in Bulgarian. Finally recieved a-two line reply in English with grammar errors, extremely non professional and rude treatment. At the end they said they will refund but it has been a while since and I have not recieved my money yet. Still no reply! Don't trust these Bulgarian mafia airlines!
reviews.author: Lina

reviews.title: Safe and secure flight
reviews.text: I am satisfied with my experience with Bulgaria Air. The flight was on time and all Covid-19 measures were fulfilled.
reviews.author: Ralitsa

reviews.title: Thank you, Bulgaria Air!
reviews.text: Тhe service during the whole trip was on level. I am satisfied, I would recommend and I would travel with Bulgaria Air again! Thank you, Bulgaria Air!
reviews.author: Martina S

reviews.title: Bad company with bad reputation.
reviews.text: Terrible company. I tried calling and emailing so many times, no answer, no refund, no credit, nothing... My flight from Vegas was cancelled and rescheduled several times by the company. Finally we were supposed to fly out on Friday morning but because our Covid Tests results did not arrive on time we were denied departure by American Airlines. Bulgaria air does not want to help us book a new flight and it doesn’t want to give us a refund either. Just the opposite of what they advertise on their website in terms of “opportunities for travel during Covid times”. I lost $3,000...more importantly never made it home to see my family after such a hard year of Covid. I have never expected that from this company. I have been flying with Bulgaria air for over 20 years now. That was my last time booking a flight through them. Wish I can sue them...and get my money back.
reviews.author: Silvia T

reviews.title: Useless customer service
reviews.text: I used them 2 times, but I would never fly again with these muppets. First flight was back in 2015. Flight itself and cabin service was fine, but they lost my daughter pushchair. Then paperwork, calls, wrong address to deliver the pushchair- nightmare. In January 2020 I booked flights to Sofia for end of May. 5 tickets- all prepaid. Due to Covid going around the world Bulgaria air canceled the flight. This is fine, all companies cancelled flights at the time. However, after around 20 tempts to get in touch I simply gave up. I was looking to receive a refund or vouchers or at least to change my flight dates. No one bother to pick up phones or to respond to emails. Totally useless customer service. Useless management as well allowing this to happen. They still don’t understand that so many negative reviews here are generated based on the non existing customer service. This pulls out customers, losses are for your company. Do not fly with Bulgaria air.
reviews.author: Stoyan N

reviews.title: WORST COMPANY!
reviews.text: My flight was canceled, and I wrote 5 emails, no respond from them, called about 32 times ( I have screenshots ) the phone was picked up and then hanged on me. They are refusing to refund any canceled flights, and because of this bad things are coming towards the company.
reviews.author: BG AIR IS THE WORST

reviews.title: Bulgaria air is a synonym of poor customer service
reviews.text: Terrible experience with Bulgaria air. As many reviews here stated, they combine multiple flights. Our flight had a "technical stop" in Frankfurt where a lot of people entered on their way to Sofia (mind they are not required to do any kind of Corona test prior to boarding!!!). The 2-hour flight turned into a 4.5 hour one. On top of that, the airline lost the luggage of everyone who got off at Berlin and we had to wait for 3 hours at the airport so that they can try and track it down. We eventually got it back several days later. Customer service has however been silent since then, completely ignoring my mails. I am not sure how this company still exists, not competitive at all.
reviews.author: Ralitsa S

reviews.title: I would rather walk than fly with this company
reviews.text: Literally, the worst possible company. All their staff is extremely rude. When they try and help you with your luggage they complain RIGHT IN FRONT of you. I speak Bulgarian and English but they thought I only spoke English. Here I am trying to make reservation to fly with my dog it has been a week with me sending 2 emails and one phone call, and on the phone call they hanged up after 2 minutes of keeping me on hold. Just extremely rude and very unreliable. The planes are from Todor Jivko’s time, nothing has changed. If there was another airline I could possibly use, I would.
reviews.author: Nicol L

reviews.title: Horrible  customer service! Avoid at all costs!
reviews.text: Horrible company with an even worse customer service. They cancelled my flight and refused to provide me with a compensation. Their customer service is abysmal. It's nearly impossible to reach them via their phone number and once you do, the staff is rude and unprofessional. They refused to even look into my issue as it was handled by a "different department" and they hung up on me mid-conversation. One of their representatives, Gabriela, is completely incompetent and needs to be fired on the spot. I also emailed them stating that the matter is urgent and they completely ignored me. They promise for a response within 24 hours, but that's a lie. I am waiting for almost a week. Once I posted about the issue on Facebook, they promised to look into it but again ignored me completely. I've been waiting for about two days.
reviews.author: Aleksandar V

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: We had to cancel our flight because of restrictions imposed by Covid. We were promised a refund but never got one and they stopped responding. If you must fly to Bulgaria seek an alternative.
reviews.author: ecoworld-DE

reviews.title: They say they care about our safety but mixed 4 different flights from different destinations.
reviews.text: In a pandemic you would think that being in contact with less people is the goal and responsibility of every person/company /government. Apparently not for Bulgaria Air. Instead, they mix several flights to make sure you get in contact with as many people as possible... The day before they changed the flight - now it passed through Frankfurt to Sofia. Instead of a direct flight from Berlin of 2 hours, the flight took more than 4 hours. They did not inform us in any way about this, I was pleasantly surprised when I arrived at the airport... This was because they combined a few flights, exposing us to people from two countries and minium 3 cities. Somehow, their statement in the beginning of the flight "We make everything we can to protect you from the virus." seems so empty and quire ironic in the view of the situation. The flight was packed so much that seat bookings overlapped with each other! I feel the need to compromise the safety of their passangers during pandemic just so they can win more money is absurd. Or if you will do it, don't even bother saying you actually care, because you clearly don't! If you have the option to travel with another company I would strongly recommend it! Bulgaria Air does not care about you.
reviews.author: SM

reviews.title: They CANCELED My Flight and NEVER Refunded my Money
reviews.text: When lockdowns started because of corona in March 2020. in South America, I was stuck in Peru. After 30 days of waiting for rescue flight back to Europe, finally I was able to go home. Rescue flight was operated by British Airways and they flew from Lima to London. Since I can't enter UK without visa, I had to buy ticket out of London asap as I land. There were no flights on the same day, but there was a flight on the next one operating by Bulgaria Air from London to Sofia. I purchased that ticket. I was about to wait 24 hours at the airport and I was fine with it. Meanwhile, Bulgaria Air canceled that flight and rescheduled for the next day. That was not fine for me as I can't spend 2 days at the airport waiting for the flight. I purchased another, more expensive flight through different city and went back home. It's almost a year and Bulgaria Air still didn't refund me my money. I tried to explain them that since they didn't operate the flight I purchased ticket for, they have no rights to keep my money. They give me some lame explanations that it takes them longer time to return money or that I can reschedule that ticket for another flight. Which one, I am asking, when whole Europe is locked at the moment. I don't want to travel, I just want my 200 euros back.
reviews.author: Nixy Jungle

reviews.title: Waiting for my refund for more than 7 months!
reviews.text: Due to COVID, the purpose of my trip was cancelled and after checking with the airline, i was informed that i can cancel the flights i have booked (2 roundtrips and 1 one way) but will only get about 40% of the value of the tickets back. After agreeing to this and cancelling the tickets, I've tried to reach out to the customer services team numerous times to check when i can expect my refund and they never replied. It has been more than 7 months since then and i am still waiting for that refund...
reviews.author: Rosen

reviews.title: They never answer ther phone !
reviews.text: It is unbelievable, I need to do changes on my reservation sometimes but they never answer my phone! Since this summer, no-one picks up the phone in their offices.
reviews.author: Eva A

reviews.title: Great flights - didn't realise we'd actually touched down!!
reviews.text: I've had many flights cancelled during COVID (BA and KLM). Bulgaria Air got me from Zurich to Sofia when I was stranded due to a KLM cancellation and also got me from Sofia to London 3 months later when BA cancelled 3 times. Not only did they get me where I needed to be, the flights were excellent. I flew back to London yesterday and I didn't actually realise we'd touched down, the landing was go smooth. Well done Bulgaria Air.
reviews.author: Ambassador249535

reviews.title: Unprofessional company, worst customer service ever!
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight for August in mid July. 3 and a half months later no refund or answer to my emails from them. No words to express how they treat their customers....
reviews.author: Alina V

reviews.title: More than OK
reviews.text: Good experience in the two flights I took. Quick and easy boarding. Clean and comfortable aircraft, cabin crew with a good level of English. Landed before the expected time in both occasions and had a very fast unboarding. Overall, it's a very good option at least for domestic flights. I had nothing to complain about.
reviews.author: shadylau

reviews.title: Promise of refund but not delivered
reviews.text: I had to cancel this flight because US and Eu restrictions made it impossible. Bulgaria Air indicated that a refund was possible but would take some time. The flight had been scheduled for June 1. Nothing further has been hear about a refund. Avoid this airline.
reviews.author: ecoworld-DE

reviews.title: Worst
reviews.text: that is honestly the smelliest plane and the dirtiest. Air hostesses looked like they was there by forced labour. No drinks or snacks..
reviews.author: terri u
